rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a prediction of future weather.

example.english: The weather forecast says it will rain in Hong Kong tonight, so remember to check it.
example.traditional: 香港今晚會落雨，記得睇天氣預報。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 gam1 maan5 wui2 lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 tai2 tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3
